documento.titulo: El Rincón de la Reflexión — The Thinking Corner
documento.descripcion: An interactive journey through the history of philosophy, organised by ideas: from the Presocratics to twentieth-century psychology, with the Chinese, Indian and Islamic traditions on their own timelines.

hero.titular: Twenty-five centuries of questions that are still open.
hero.entradilla: A journey through the ideas, not the names. The West, China, India, the Islamic world and twentieth-century psychology, each tradition on its own timeline. Every idea can be handled: it isn't illustrated, it's tested.
hero.escena: A seated figure leaning forward, elbow on knee, in the attitude of thinking

secciones.cuerpo: The texts are written and synthesised from academic sources, never copied. Quotations are short excerpts with their work named, and those of traditional or doubtful attribution are flagged as such within the profile itself.
The fifty-nine pieces along the journey are our own geometry, physics and animation. There are no third-party illustrations.

Based on a photogrammetry scan of Rodin’s The Thinker by Rigsters, used under a Creative Commons Attribution licence (CC BY). Modifications: mesh reduced from 50,974 to 25,486 triangles, textures removed, and recentred and rescaled for the framing. The bronze and the lighting are our own. Rodin’s sculpture is in the public domain — he died in 1917; what is licensed is the scan, which is a separate work.
